get.description: Liveness — the process is up.
Readiness — can reach Postgres + Redis.

put.description: Replace the standing-order lines (upsert by product; drop missing ones).

post.description: Modify a single date (skip / change qty). Server enforces the next-day cutoff.

get.description: Effective quantities for a date (default = tomorrow): template merged with overrides.

post.description: Clone a past order's items into a fresh order for the same customer.

Customer cancels their own order while it's still cancellable (not yet paid or
dispatched). A paid order must be refunded by support instead (409).

Issue (or fetch the existing) GST tax invoice for a paid one-time order. Idempotent.
An order refunded (in part or whole) before its first invoice gets the invoice AND the
credit note for what was already refunded, so output GST isn't over-reported.

get.description:
Live status for a one-time order: order + payment state plus each courier shipment
with its latest tracking events (newest first).

post.description:
Upload a POD photo/signature; returns a URL to pass as pod.photo_url/signature_url.
Validated by magic bytes and stored with a server-chosen content-type.

get.description:
Delivery orders for a date, scoped to the caller's shops (delivery=assigned,
subscriber=owned, admin=all).

post.description: Mark a stop delivered: per-item quantities (partial OK), POD, returns, cash.
Driver GPS ping (append-only; latest row is the driver's current position).

get.description:
The caller's assigned stops for a date as an ordered route with sequence numbers.
Ordered by shop_id (stable); geo nearest-neighbor from the driver's latest location
is a future enhancement once shops carry geo.
Per-day counts (delivered/failed/pending) + cash collected, scoped to the caller.

post.description: Mark an assigned stop failed with a reason (no billing/stock movement).

get.description:
The caller's full wallet ledger, newest first (`?limit=&offset=`, total in
`X-Total-Count`). Read-only and scoped to the caller's own account.

Line-item statement for an account on credit terms (B2B postpaid): every charge,
payment and credit note with the running outstanding, newest first (`?limit=&offset=`,
total in `X-Total-Count`). Scoped to the caller's own account; an account that was
never on credit simply has no lines.

post.description: Customer requests a wallet payout (must have the balance; admin approves).

Refund a successful payment (full or partial). Top-up refunds reverse the wallet
credit; order-payment refunds return money to source and mark the order refunded.

Double-refund safety: the payment row is locked FOR UPDATE for the whole read-cap +
insert-'initiated' section; the cap counts EVERY non-'failed' refund; and while any
refund on the payment is unresolved (initiated/pending — the gateway outcome is
unknown) a NEW refund is refused, so retrying a timed-out partial refund can never
issue a second real one. Unresolved refunds are settled via the reconcile endpoint.

Admin settles a refund whose gateway outcome was unknown (pending/initiated), or
re-applies the ledger effect of a processed refund whose follow-up update failed.

Gateway callback. Signature-verified, idempotent by event id. Unknown events
are acknowledged. Finalizes a captured payment that the client never verified.

Materialize active subscriptions into delivery_orders for a date (default tomorrow).
Today/past dates are refused unless force=true: a rerun on delivery day rebuilds open
orders mid-route, and a past date would create orders that then get billed.

get.description: Cutoff batch history, newest first (filter by status / delivery-date range).
When the next cutoff is, whether tomorrow is already frozen, and the last run.

post.description: Emit an event for one user (gating applies) and return the rows created.

get.description:
Next-day production plan: known committed standing orders + forecast of the
variable (one-time) demand, with a service-level safety buffer, per product.

post.description: Drain due queued notifications (also runs automatically in the ARQ worker).
Re-queue a failed/sent notification for immediate redelivery.

get.description: Distinct categories among active products (storefront nav/facets).
One variant by id, whatever its status (admin edit screens).
Data access + portability: everything we hold about the caller.

post.description:
Right to erasure — anonymizes PII; tax/financial records are retained by law.
Irreversible, so it requires step-up confirmation with a fresh OTP.

Save the instrument of one of the caller's own SUCCESSFUL gateway payments. The
token, customer id, brand and last digits come from the gateway's record of that
payment — never from the client.
The customer revokes an autopay mandate (they must always be able to).

get.description: Driver <-> shop assignments, newest first, with driver and shop names.

patch.description:
Correct an account's type / billing mode (accounts were typed by whichever endpoint
first created them, and nothing else could change it).

post.description:
Provision a staff account (delivery/admin/subscriber) by phone. Customers still
self-register via OTP; this is how drivers/staff get onboarded. The account is
phone-verified so the user can log in with an OTP immediately.
Admin wallet correction/goodwill (signed). Negative is allowed (override).
Record a payment received against a B2B postpaid account's outstanding credit.

get.description: One shop with its owner, price tier, standing order and assigned drivers.
At-a-glance operational + financial counters for the admin dashboard.
Items at or below their reorder point (reorder_point > 0).

For each item at/below its reorder point, suggest a replenishment qty that
tops it back up to 2x the reorder point (a starting point for a purchase order).

post.description: Write off batches past their expiry date (as_of defaults to today).

get.description:
No login required (the answer doesn't depend on who asks). Anonymous traffic is
bounded by the global per-IP rate limit, and answers are cached briefly so repeated
lookups don't each cost a courier API call.

post.description:
One-call pre-pay quote the web checkout can show before paying: line totals,
subtotal, coupon discount, indicative GST (on the discounted base), and — if a
pincode is given — courier serviceability. Read-only; never reserves the coupon.

get.description:
One return with its order, customer, refund limits and the refund it produced:
the store-credit wallet entry and any GST credit notes on the order.
Any ticket with its thread (the customer endpoint only serves the owner's).
One article in any status (drafts included) for the admin editor.
Check a gift card's remaining balance/status by its code (before redeeming).

post.description: Fire a test delivery at this webhook (uses the real dispatch, fail-soft).

get.description:
Catalogue list for the admin dashboard. Unlike the storefront `/products`
(active only, cached) this can include retired products and reports a total.

post.description:
Register (or re-activate) this device for push. Idempotent on the token.

An FCM token is per app-install, not per user: when a different user signs in on
the same device, re-registering legitimately moves the token to them (which detaches
the previous owner). We audit that reassignment rather than doing it silently.

Deactivate a device token, sent in the BODY (preferred: the DELETE /{token} form
puts the push token in the URL, i.e. in access logs and traces).

delete.description:
Deactivate a device token (logout / uninstall). Only the owner's token is touched.
Deprecated: use POST /unregister (keeps the token out of URLs/logs).

post.description:
Double opt-in: a subscribe creates/keeps a PENDING record with a confirm token
and emails a confirmation link. Consent (consent_at) is recorded only when the real
email owner confirms — so one can't subscribe or forge consent for someone else.
Already-subscribed emails stay subscribed (idempotent).

get.description:
NON-mutating: report whether a confirm token is still valid so the landing page can
render a 'Confirm subscription' button. Consent is NOT recorded here — an email client
or link-scanner that prefetches the GET link must not auto-confirm (DPDP intent). The
actual confirmation is the POST below, triggered by an explicit user click.

post.description:
Confirm a pending subscription via the emailed token — records consent. POST so a
prefetch/scanner GET of the email link can't record consent without a user action.

get.description:
Order a date's delivery stops into a short route using shop geo (stops without
coordinates keep their input order). Pass delivery_id to route one driver's stops
(their assigned shops); a single call is capped at routing.MAX_STOPS stops.

post.description: Customer support bot grounded in the caller's own recent orders.
Admin copilot grounded in live aggregate metrics (sanitized, no PII).

get.description: The account's append-only wallet ledger, newest first (txn_type as entry_type).
The account's postpaid receivables ledger (+charge, -payment/credit note), newest first.

Everything captured at the door for one delivery order: proof of delivery (with
signed, short-lived media URLs), cash/UPI collected and returned lines.

post.description:
Upload an image (JPEG/PNG/WEBP, ≤5 MB); returns a URL to attach to an RMA or ticket.
The file is validated by magic bytes and stored with a server-chosen content-type.

CreditLedgerLineOut.title: CreditLedgerLineOut
CreditLedgerLineOut.description: One line of a B2B credit-terms statement (append-only receivables ledger).

DataExportOut.title: DataExportOut
DataExportOut.description:
DPDP data export. Values are intentionally loose (dict/list) — this is a
portability dump, not a stable typed resource. Every PII-bearing table keyed to the
subject (user id or their accounts) is included, all columns except secrets.

RMARefundCreditOut.title: RMARefundCreditOut
RMARefundCreditOut.description: Store credit paid for a return (a wallet ledger row with ref_type='rma').

WalletTxnLineOut.title: WalletTxnLineOut
WalletTxnLineOut.description: One line of the customer's wallet ledger (append-only).
